name: Functional Correctness
description: Build clean (bun build). Tests pass (bun test). Auth (cookie + Bearer), device CRUD + provisioning, hawkBit operations, deployments, artifacts all functional. Device delete = unclaim (hawkBit target preserved). Deprovision = permanent removal (super admin only). hawkBit sync engine guards on hawkbitConfig.enabled. Background sync worker runs on interval. Better Auth plugins must be array [bearer()], not object.

name: Code Quality
description: Every file under 250 lines. Clean separation: schemas.ts (types) → index.ts / routes.ts (handlers) → service.ts (logic) → hawkbit client (adapter). No inline response schemas in route files — all imported from schemas.ts. Logger uses %s format strings (never pass unknown/number as second arg).

name: Schema Organization
description: Each module's schemas.ts owns all body, response, and shared param schemas. ErrorResponseSchema and GenericActionResponseSchema in common/schemas, re-exported by each module. Route files NEVER define response schemas inline. Params/query schemas may live in schemas.ts or locally in route files. Use t.Date() for Drizzle timestamp columns (never t.String with format: date-time).

name: Error Handling
description: Two-level hawkBit error protection: (1) service checks hawkbitConfig.enabled → 400, (2) route catches network errors → 503. HawkbitApiError wraps external failures. Sync catches errors silently. Pino uses %s format strings for type-safe logging.

name: Test Coverage
description: 10 integration test files + 1 unit test file covering auth, devices, deployments, artifacts, categories, companies, health, posts, provisioning, SSE. Tests validate auth (superAdmin macro), authorization, validation, CRUD. Separate test DB (Neon). afterAll() cleans all tables via cleanAll(). Idempotent runs. HAWKBIT_ENABLED=false in tests.

name: Config Centralization
description: ALL config flows through env.ts (TypeBox validated). No process.env reads outside env.ts. New vars added to: (1) env.ts schema, (2) .env.example, (3) .env.test simultaneously. CDN config is hawkBit-side (Spring properties), not Ninbus API.

name: Security
description: Super admin via SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS env var (superAdmin macro). Company RBAC via companyRole macro (owner/admin/operator/viewer). Device removal from company = unclaim (hawkBit preserved). Only deprovision (super admin) removes from hawkBit. hawkBit guard on all external calls. deviceKey never stored in DB. Better Auth plugins as array [bearer()].

name: 🔮 Futuro (Aprendizado Contínuo)
description: Principles in .harness/principles.json covering architecture, security, testing, process, quality. SKILL.md and references updated with current state. README reflects actual codebase. Key patterns: unclaim vs deprovision, superAdmin macro, Better Auth plugin format, two-level hawkBit error protection, CDN in hawkBit Java extension.
